Ava — thanks for sending this over and apologies for the delay. Quick checklist so Finance can finish vendor setup and issue payment: 

1) Please upload a completed W-9 (we need taxpayer name, EIN, and signature). We classify US entities for 1099 purposes.
2) Confirm legal entity name matches the W-9 exactly (you indicated "Acme Biosciences LLC").
3) Remittance address to be used for ACH/Check: confirm street + city/state/ZIP, and provide bank ACH details if you prefer ACH.
4) Billing contact (if different from you) and preferred payment terms — Redwood processes Net 30 by default unless contract states otherwise.

For faster onboarding you can use our vendor portal to upload documents: https://vendor-portal.redwood.com/upload/verify?token=xyz123 (link valid for 7 days). I'll loop Finance to confirm once the W-9 is received.
